2. Hazard(s) identification

This material is a food ingredient. It is not classified as hazardous under 29 CFR 1910.1200, no GHS pictogram or hazard statement applies to it, and no signal word is assigned. Dust generated during handling may form a combustible atmosphere in confined spaces; ground and bond transfer equipment. Note for site personnel: the caustic CIP concentrate stored in the same building IS classified, carries the signal word DANGER, and has its own safety data sheet — do not read the two sheets together.
